thread:
Priya (PM): Heads up from sales: Customer Beacon requires per-tenant rate limits + UI toggle for pilot. They called it a pilot "must-have" for compliance.
Ivy R: Do they mean soft throttles or strict quota enforcement?
Priya (PM): Prefer strict quotas for the pilot, but they'll accept soft enforcement if we ship visibility + admin toggle.
Noah G: Strict quotas mean quota store + token accounting. Quick estimate: 6d eng + 2d infra. Soft mode = 2d eng + config + logs.
Sam K: Infra impact: need per-tenant tenant_id in requests and an in-memory counters service or Redis. Redis adds ops overhead but faster.
Priya (PM): Risk: strict quotas will push our v1 timeline unless we parallelize. Pilot is in 4 weeks.
Ivy R: Proposal: ship soft enforcement in MVP with admin toggle + metrics, target strict enforcement in v1. Add compatibility hooks to swap in quota backend later.
Noah G: Agree. We'll add a feature-flagged middleware: if flag=on use strict path. Create ENG-4021 (middleware), ENG-4022 (admin UI), INF-211 (redis eval).
deploy-bot: Reminder: Feature flags require smoke tests before canary. See: https://go/feature-flags
Sam K: I'll validate Redis cost + HA by EOD. If Redis is too heavy, we can use a sharded in-memory with graceful degradation.
Priya (PM): I'll confirm with Beacon that soft enforcement + UI is acceptable and get written signoff. Also will update milestone tracker and notify CS.
Ivy R: Add QA ticket for quota edge-cases and burst behavior.
Noah G: Triage to tomorrow's eng planning. If Beacon insists on strict, we'll have to shift MVP by ~10 business days.
Priya (PM): Thanks all — short sync. Action items: Priya -> written ok from Beacon, Sam -> infra cost, Ivy -> QA ticket, Noah -> ENG tasks.
Sam K: 👍 posting infra note shortly.
Priya (PM): I'll update the roadmap slice and send a status note to sales.
